description: Japan’s Digital Agency said a cyberattack on its Government Solution Service network may have exposed personal information from about 246,000 government workers, public servants, contractors, and other individuals. The breach was traced to a vulnerability in a VPN device. Authorities said no personal information of ordinary citizens was involved and no misuse has been detected so far.
title: Japan Digital Agency Reports Potential Leak of 246,000 Records After Cyberattack

description: Google has rolled out a new Android transfer system that lets compatible password managers exchange passwords and passkeys directly. The feature removes the need to export passwords as unencrypted text files and provides a way to move passkeys when changing services. Android detects supported password managers on the device and guides users through selecting, reviewing and authorising the transfer. Google Password Manager, 1Password, Bitwarden Password Manager and Dashlane currently support the feature, while additional providers are expected to join later.
title: Google Makes It Easier to Switch Password Managers on Android: How to Transfer Passwords and Passkeys

description: Danmarks Nationalbank has warned that wider stablecoin adoption could eventually affect payments, financial stability, and monetary policy in Denmark. While domestic use remains limited, easier access through banks, fintechs, and payment platforms could increase adoption. The central bank also highlighted risks from dollar-backed stablecoins and potential spillovers from US and global financial markets.
title: Denmark Central Bank Flags Risks as Stablecoin Market Expands

description: Samsung is reportedly working on new Android XR glasses with a colour display. It will reportedly launch next year. It could feature ultra-small microdisplays measuring around 0.2 inches. Samsung’s first Android XR glasses will not have a display and are likely to resemble Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses. It is said to go official later this year.
title: Samsung's Rumoured Android XR Smart Glasses With Colour Display: All You Need to Know

description: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag 3 has appeared in leaked images that show a squircle-shaped body, a circular centre and possible Black and White finishes. The tracker may lack a built-in attachment hole, potentially requiring a separate case for keys and bags. Its reported European price is EUR 45.95 (roughly Rs. 5,100), while the US price could remain unchanged at $29.99 (roughly Rs. 2,900). A South Korean certification also suggests it may launch soon.
title: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag 3 Design, Colourways and Price Leaked Online

description: The Poco X8, launched on September 4, goes on sale today in India. The phone has a 6.83-inch display, runs a Qualcomm Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 processor and has a 50-megapixel primary camera. It ships with Xiaomi’s HyperOS 3, which is based on Android 16.
title: Poco X8 and Poco X8 Power Go on Sale in India for the First Time Today: Price, Specifications, Sale Offers

description: NPCI has introduced two new services designed to change how users make and manage UPI payments. UPI Tap & Pay uses NFC to let customers pay through compatible POS terminals, with transactions relying on the terminal's internet connection. MyUPI expands UPI Help with AI-based features covering payment records, AutoPay mandates, beneficiary information, transaction disputes and payment controls. The service will also support transaction repetition and multilingual assistance. Both services were announced by RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra at GFF 2026.
title: NPCI Launches UPI Tap & Pay, MyUPI With NFC Payments and AI-Powered Tools

description: Nothing is said to be gearing up to launch a new pair of premium over-ear headphones. According to a report, the purported wearable could arrive as the follow-up to the flagship Headphone (1) and the more affordable Headphone (a). The device, dubbed the Nothing Headphone (1) Pro, is reported to offer a more advanced audio setup, adaptive ANC and upgraded connectivity. The purported headphones may feature a triple-driver architecture, including XMEMS technology for the high frequencies.
title: Nothing Headphone (1) Pro Price, Specifications Leaked Ahead of Launch

description: Google has introduced ADB Wi-Fi 2.0 with a new server stack and smarter network handling to directly address developer feedback around usability gaps. Google states that the auto-connection success rates improved by 32 percent and connection speeds increased by 66 percent for 90 percent of connections. The ADB Wi-Fi 2.0 can be used on your phone, tablet, Wear OS, and TV.
title: Google Introduces ADB Wi-Fi 2.0 to Improve Wireless Debugging, Pairing

description: Snapchat Plans has been launched as a new suite of features for managing events within the Snapchat app. The new set of features allow users to send and receive invitations from mutual friends, track key details like time, date, and attendees, and view plans in one “easy-to-find” place within the Snapchat app. On top of this, the company said that soon users will be able to create events directly within a chat window on Snapchat. The social media platform allows users to send invites to up to 200 other users, including friends, family members, and acquaintances.
title: Snapchat Plans Lets Users Manage Event Invites, Dates and Attendees in One Place

description: OpenAI on Thursday announced ChatGPT for financial services as a specialised ChatGPT Work experience to help financial institutions with research, financial modelling and client-facing materials. The San Francisco-based company said that it combines built-in financial datasets from providers like Daloopa, PitchBook, LSEG News and Crunchbase with GPT-6 Astra's reasoning and document-generation capabilities. The platform also includes enterprise-grade security controls, firm-specific templates, and more than 50 connectors for financial and business applications.
title: ChatGPT for Financial Services Launched With Financial Data, AI Reasoning and Enterprise Controls

description: Bitcoin has extended its recent decline as profit-taking, weaker institutional demand and increased derivatives positioning weigh on the market. Rising crude prices and geopolitical tensions are adding further pressure, while traders watch key support levels for signs of stabilisation.
title: Bitcoin’s Four-Session Slide Puts $76,000 Support in Focus

description: Lava Bold N4 Pro 5G will be launched in India on September 18 at 12 pm IST, the Noida-based smartphone maker revealed on Friday. On top of this, the microsite reveals that the new Lava Bold N4 Pro 5G will be equipped with a 6,000mAh battery. The phone will be available for purchase in the country via Amazon. It will go on sale in India in gold and blue colour options. Moreover, it will be equipped with a dual rear camera system, headlined by a 50-megapixel primary shooter.
title: Lava Bold N4 Pro 5G India Launch Date Revealed Along With Key Specifications, Design and More

description: Apple's new family-focused subscription brings together protection for eligible products used by members of a Family Sharing group. The service covers devices that meet Apple's age and condition requirements and can also include products bought after enrolment. Subscribers can manage the covered hardware through Apple's devices and adjust the list when required. The plan also sets a yearly allowance for theft and loss claims across the group. AppleCare One Family will launch in the US on September 14, while availability elsewhere remains unconfirmed.
title: Apple Launches AppleCare One Family Plan With Multi-Device Coverage for Six People

description: Ubisoft is first testing the feature in Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown. Ubisoft Connect Services will allow players to launch the game and access features like cross-progression, cross-play, player safety, challenges and rewards, among others, without installing and launching the Ubisoft Connect PC launcher.
title: Ubisoft Games on Steam Will No Longer Require Ubisoft Connect PC Launcher

description: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipsets have been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform. The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset outperformed the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC in terms of single-core and multi-core performance, along with peak clock speed. The Snapdragon 8 series SoC managed to score 3,582 and 12,247 points on Geekbench’s single-core and multi-core performance tests. Meanwhile, the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chip scored 3,242 and 11,132 on the two benchmarking tests, respectively.
title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Outperforms MediaTek’s Upcoming Flagship Smartphone Chipset

description: AMD has launched Ryzen 5 7500 and Ryzen 5 5500F. The new CPUs target AMD's AM5 and AM4 platforms, respectively. The AMD Ryzen 5 7500 brings integrated Radeon Graphics to the AM5 platform. It features six cores and 12 threads, with a maximum clock speed of up to 5GHz and a base frequency of 3.7GHz.
title: AMD Ryzen 7500 and Ryzen 5 5500F Desktop Processors Launched: Specifications, Features

description: iQOO 16 design, colourway, and camera-related details have been revealed by the Vivo sub-brand. Housed inside a square-shaped deco, with a raised boundary around it, the iQOO 16 is now equipped with a “robotic arm” (translated from Chinese) design, which connects the three camera lenses. The Vivo sub-brand says that the iQOO 16’s camera layout forms a “navigator” (translated from Chinese) symbol. The smartphone will also feature a glass rear panel, with a new “hexagonal tech pattern”. The smartphone will be available for purchase in at least a Light Chasing colour option.
title: iQOO 16 Design, Colourway Revealed as Firm Confirms Major Camera Upgrade

description: India has settled Rs. 1,025 crore worth of tokenised corporate bond transactions using the RBI’s wholesale digital rupee. The Demat 2.0 pilot connects statutory depositories’ distributed ledger systems with the RBI’s Unified Market Interface, enabling simultaneous settlement of securities and cash. REC, Larsen & Toubro, and IIFL participated in the first three deals.
title: India Adopts Digital Rupee for Bond Transaction Settlements

description: Krafton India has announced that the 4.6 update for Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) will roll out on September 16. The update will introduce a Midnight Hunters-themed mode that transforms Erangel with darker surroundings. The theme mode will remain available until November 16. Ocean Odyssey will return to Erangel on September 30. Players can encounter Bloodwalkers, Nightbats and the Vampire Elder in the new version.
title: BGMI 4.6 Update Set to Arrive on September 16 With Supernatural Midnight Hunters Theme Mode

description: Instagram has started rolling out a new profile feature that lets users bring tagged posts onto their main grid. The change gives users greater control over which posts associated with them are visible alongside their own uploads. Instagram provides multiple ways to add a tagged post, including through notifications, the post menu and the Tagged tab. Added posts follow the profile's default ordering, while users can later remove them from the grid without deleting the original post or removing the tag.
title: Instagram Lets Users Add Tagged Posts to Their Main Profile Grid

description: Nubia has outlined the key hardware and software features of the NaviX Ultra ahead of its September 16 debut. The handset will use a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and LPDDR5X memory supplied by CXMT, with speeds reaching 10,667Mbps. It will also carry a triple rear camera system, a 50-megapixel selfie camera and a system-level Doubao assistant. Nubia has named BOE, Samsung Semiconductor and Goodix Technology among its component partners, while pricing and market availability remain undisclosed.
title: Nubia NaviX Ultra Key Features Confirmed Ahead of September 16 Launch

description: Sony’s unannounced Xperia 1 IX is said to get a new primary camera sensor. The Xperia 1 IX will succeed the Xperia 1 VIII, currently on sale in select markets globally. According to a new report, the unannounced smartphone will feature a larger primary camera sensor, which hasn’t been updated since the Xperia 1 V.
title: Sony Xperia 1 IX Tipped to Get a Bigger Primary Camera Sensor, Redesigned Module

description: Samsung recently introduced its first Galaxy Glasses, developed with Google, Gentle Monster, and Warby Parker. A new report suggests that the South Korean tech conglomerate could be working on a more advanced version that adds visual information to the glasses. Samsung has reportedly asked its display division to develop a microdisplay for AI glasses. This could potentially enable features such as notifications, navigation cues, and text directly in the user's field of view.
title: Samsung Reportedly Developing Display-Equipped AI Glasses, Launch Slated for 2028

description: Mivi One 5G will be launched in India in three colour options, namely Burgundy, Blue, and Green, the company announced on Thursday. The company has also updated the dedicated microsite for the upcoming handset to show the three shades. Apart from this, the microsite has been updated to reveal that the Mivi One 5G will be equipped with 128GB of onboard storage. We already know that the Mivi One 5G will be launched in India on September 24. The smartphone is confirmed to go on sale in the country via Flipkart. It will arrive as the first handset from the tech firm.
title: Mivi One 5G Colour Options and More Details Revealed Days Before India Launch
How Samsung Made Folding Phones Feel Normal: Eight Generations of the Galaxy Fold

description: Oppo K14 Lite is set to launch in India next week, the company announced on Friday. The new Oppo K series smartphone is confirmed to go on sale through Flipkart in the country. The official teasers shared by the brand reveal the design, colour options and battery details.
title: Oppo K14 Lite India Launch Date Announced; Teased to Feature 7,000mAh Battery

description: Xbox is now set to publish Hideo Kojima's tactical espionage title, Physint, after Sony announced it was backing out of the project. The game will be published by Xbox Game Studios, which is also set to publish Hideo Kojima's horror title, OD.
title: Hideo Kojima's Espionage Game Physint Changes Hands From PlayStation to Xbox After Sony Backs Out of Project

description: Garmin has recently been rumoured to be foraying into the smart ring segment with a new Cirq device. A new report suggests that the company could have another Cirqa device in development. References found in the latest Garmin Connect app reportedly point to a Cirqa smart band, with the software mentioning two physical buttons, alarms, and audio feedback. The clues suggest the purported wearable could offer a more interactive experience than the existing screen-less bands in the company’s portfolio.
title: Garmin Cirqa Smart Band Pro Reportedly in Development With Two Buttons, Audio Feedback: Report

description: Redmi Note 17 Pro and Redmi Note 17 Pro Max will be powered by Qualcomm's octa-core Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 and Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipsets, respectively, the Xiaomi sub-brand revealed on Friday. Moreover, the Pro Max model will sport a “photochromic, colour-changing material” on the back, available only with the Secret Sunshine colour option. Apart from this, the tech firm claims that the upcoming Redmi Note 17 Pro series will ship with an IP69K rating for dust and water resistance.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro, Note 17 Pro Max Chipsets, IP Ratings Revealed Ahead of India Launch

description: Samsung’s flagship smartphones could become more expensive in India soon. According to a tipster, a price hike is on the cards for the Galaxy S26 Ultra, which sits atop the latest Galaxy S26 series and currently starts at Rs. 1,39,999 for the base model with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of onboard storage. Meanwhile, the tipster also suggested that the South Korean tech conglomerate’s latest-generation foldables, the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, could see similar price hikes.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Tipped to Get Price Hike in India Soon; Galaxy Z Fold 8, Fold 8 Ultra Could Follow Suit

description: The Xiaomi 18 series is expected to debut in China this month as the company's next flagship. While handsets typically arrive in China first, followed by a global rollout several months later, a new certification listing could hint at an earlier international launch for the vanilla Xiaomi 18. The purported global variant is reported to have surfaced in a regional listing that reveals its storage configurations, IP68 protection, and fast-charging support.
title: Xiaomi 18 Global Variant Reportedly Gets NCC Certification; Storage Options, Charging Speed Leaked

description: Google launched a dedicated Gemini app for Windows on Thursday. The app provides users with access to the Mountain View-based tech giant’s AI assistant without having to keep a browser tab open. Google says it has designed the Gemini app to work alongside other apps, enabling it to be called up while simultaneously working on documents, presentations, or other tasks. The company also plans to introduce more native desktop capabilities via future updates.
title: Google Rolls Out Gemini App for Windows With Video Generation Support, Multi Agents

description: Vivo V2559, which is believed to be the global version of the Vivo X Fold 6, has been spotted on Geekbench, indicating that its international launch could be approaching. The listing shows a single-core score of 1,710 and a multi-core score of 5,977. It could run on an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset (MediaTek MT6993). The processor is paired with 12GB of RAM. It also runs Android 17.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Global Variant Pops Up on Geekbench With MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chipset

description: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max battery capacities have been revealed in a new regulatory filing from Apple to the European Product Registry for Energy Labelling (EPREL). According to the regulatory filing, the iPhone 18 Pro has a rated battery capacity of 4,056mAh, delivering 52 hours of battery endurance per cycle. On the other hand, the iPhone 18 Pro Max has been listed with a rated battery capacity of 5,391mAh, providing a total battery endurance per cycle (100 to 0 percent) of 62 hours. Both smartphones have been awarded the energy label or rating of ‘A’. Moreover, the handsets have been rated ‘B’ for drop endurance and ‘C’ for repairability. Similarly, the iPhone 18 Pro series is shown to ship with an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Feature Notably Larger Batteries Than Their Predecessors, Reveals Regulatory Filing

description: Samsung has taken the Galaxy Watch 4 and Galaxy Watch 4 Classic off its quarterly security update list, ending official maintenance for the 2021 smartwatches. The August 2026 security patch was the final update for both models. Samsung had previously delivered four Wear OS generations to the series, taking it from Wear OS 3.5 to Wear OS 6. The Galaxy Watch 5 series is now the oldest generation covered by Samsung's quarterly wearable security programme, while the Galaxy Watch FE continues to receive updates.
title: Samsung Ends Support for Galaxy Watch 4 and Galaxy Watch 4 Classic After Five Years
